zones.paint_help: Same-kind zones merge when their edges touch. Diagonal contact stays separate. Erasing removes only the dragged area and keeps the rest. Farm preview counts newly cultivable tiles.
zones.erase_hint: Erase only the dragged area. Remaining tiles stay designated; disconnected pieces become separate zones.
zones.too_large: Paint up to 900 tiles at once. Add a neighboring area to expand the zone.
